shortDescription: Configures the iDRAC eventing related attributes

options.name: address
options.description: Email address for SNMP Trap.

options.name: alert_number
options.description: Alert number for Email configuration.

options.name: authentication
options.description: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol Authentication.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: custom_message
options.description: Custom message for SNMP Trap reference.

options.name: destination
options.description: Destination for SNMP Trap.

options.name: destination_number
options.description: Destination number for SNMP Trap.

options.name: email_alert_state
options.description: Whether to Enable or Disable Email alert.

options.name: enable_alerts
options.description: Whether to Enable or Disable iDRAC alerts.

options.name: idrac_ip
options.description: iDRAC IP Address.

options.name: idrac_password
options.description: iDRAC user password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export IDRAC_PASSWORD=password

options.name: idrac_port
options.description: iDRAC port.

options.name: idrac_user
options.description: iDRAC username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. Example: export IDRAC_USERNAME=username

options.name: password
options.description: Password for SMTP authentication.

options.name: share_mnt
options.description: (deprecated)Local mount path of the network share with read-write permission for ansible user. This option is mandatory for Network Share. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_name
options.description: (deprecated)Network share or a local path. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_password
options.description: (deprecated)Network share user password. This option is mandatory for CIFS Network Share. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_user
options.description: (deprecated)Network share user in the format 'user@domain' or 'domain\user' if user is part of a domain else 'user'. This option is mandatory for CIFS Network Share. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: smtp_ip_address
options.description: Enter the IPv4 or IPv6 address of the SMTP server or the FQDN or DNS name.

options.name: smtp_port
options.description: SMTP Port number for access.

options.name: snmp_trap_state
options.description: Whether to Enable or Disable SNMP alert.

options.name: snmp_v3_username
options.description: SNMP v3 username for SNMP Trap.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for SMTP authentication.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.
